shortDescription: Manage CIFS server on Unity storage system

options.name: cifs_server_id
options.description: The ID of the CIFS server.

options.name: cifs_server_name
options.description: The name of the CIFS server.

options.name: domain
options.description: The domain name where the SMB server is registered in Active Directory.

options.name: interfaces
options.description: List of file IP interfaces that service CIFS protocol of SMB server.

options.name: nas_server_id
options.description: ID of the NAS server on which CIFS server will be hosted.

options.name: nas_server_name
options.description: Name of the NAS server on which CIFS server will be hosted.

options.name: netbios_name
options.description: The computer name of the SMB server in Windows network.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unity management server.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with Unity management server.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the CIFS server should exist or not.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unity management server.

options.name: unjoin_cifs_server_account
options.description: Keep SMB server account unjoined in Active Directory after deletion. C(false) specifies keep SMB server account joined after deletion. C(true) specifies unjoin SMB server account from Active Directory before deletion.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the Unity management server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
